description:
FILED s487 (Fable, 2026-09-16) from a USER question: "if someone d/l Percolisp from GitHub, will it be easy to start doing tests with Claude Code? How much functionality is kept in ~/.claude/?"  MEASURED ANSWER: the tests are easy (CI runs the installer + tools/prove-core from a clean checkout; .claude/settings.json + .claude/hooks/ are TRACKED); the DEVELOPMENT PROCESS is not reproducible from a clone because three stores live outside the repo:

1. THE TASK STORE ~/.claude/tasks/pcl/NNN.json -- Claude Code keeps the task list at ~/.claude/tasks/<CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID>/ and the id here is `pcl`.  1,150 files, 5.8 MB.  The docs point into it everywhere: DECIDED.md 3,442 refs / 934 distinct tasks; CLAUDE.md 479 / 197; not-supported.md 187 / 103; plan-post-s433.md 490 / 176.  COMMON.md and CLAUDE.md tell agents to "grep the task store".
2. ~/pcl-agent-scratch -- COMMON.md (the agent rulebook), every round brief (prompt.md / prompt.launch.md), the round plans (s473t6/plan.md ...), the PAUSE/restart files (s470/PAUSE-s474.md), README.proposed.md.  DECIDED and session-log cite the path 15 times each.  The tree is 1.8 GB apparent, almost all archived faillogs / suitelogs / measurement outputs under the *-agent-* dirs (regenerable); the Markdown is small.
3. ~/.claude/projects/-home-bernt-pcl/memory/ -- 136 files, 0.9 MB, Claude's own notes (working-style rules, state pointers, measurement traps).  By rule the durable rulings already go to DECIDED + session-log; this is the least of the three and its inclusion is the USER's call.

DESIGN (two-way, no export step): (a) move ~/.claude/tasks/pcl INTO the checkout as tasks/ and leave a SYMLINK at the old path -- every reader/writer (the Perl helpers, the agents, Claude Code's own task tools) keeps its path; git becomes the audit trail.  WRINKLE: an agent in a worktree writes through the symlink into MAIN's working tree, not its branch -- task changes are committed on main by Fable at each merge (one file per task: no conflicts; concurrent edits to one task = last-write-wins, as today).  Add a tools/t row: every task file parses, ids unique, next-free = max+1.  (b) memory: the same symlink trick (~/.claude/projects/<path>/memory -> <repo>/.claude/memory) if the USER wants it tracked; a newcomer's Claude Code auto-loads it only if they symlink likewise (the path is per machine); otherwise it reads as docs.  (c) briefs/plans/COMMON.md/PAUSE: plain move into docs/agents/ (or similar); update the ~30 path citations in DECIDED + session-log + COMMON.md itself; measurement outputs stay out (the agents' untracked scratch/ already is).  A newcomer then needs: clone, `export CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID=pcl`, the symlink(s) -- write that into CONTRIBUTING.md or a docs/handover.md.

PUBLISHABILITY, checked 2026-09-16: no email address, personal name, password, key or token text in either store (the `token` hits are PPI lexer talk); 17 task texts and 5 memory files mention /home/bernt (harmless, machine-specific).  Repo growth: +6 MB now, a few hundred KB per session.

CAN BE DONE WHILE AGENTS RUN (the path they write to does not change).  USER 2026-09-16: "let's leave this for later. Please remind me in a few weeks."  -> the reminder lives in memory (MEMORY.md top line) AND here; the FIRST Fable session on or after 2026-10-07 raises it.  The larger USER goal behind it -- the project must be ready for someone else to take over -- is a standing consideration from now: anything a successor needs goes into the repo (DECIDED / docs), never only into memory or scratch.

=== STARTED s507 (Fable, 2026-10-04) -- USER: do it now, carefully; destination named `dot-claude-in-home-dir/` (the USER`s suggestion, for readers who do not know Claude Code); check that nothing embarrassing is published ===
DONE (filesystem, both verified by sha256 over every file before the swap; the swap is `mv OLD BACKUP && ln -s NEW OLD`; backup vs live diffed after it: identical):
  (a) TASK STORE: ~/.claude/tasks/pcl -> /home/bernt/pcl/dot-claude-in-home-dir/tasks/pcl (1,502 task files + .highwatermark .lock .s470br-note); pre-move original kept at ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s507/tasks-pcl-before-move.  Done while two agents were running; nothing was written in the gap.
  (b) MEMORY: ~/.claude/projects/-home-bernt-pcl/memory -> /home/bernt/pcl/dot-claude-in-home-dir/memory (143 files); original kept at ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s507/memory-before-move.  A write through the old path lands in the repo copy (tested with MEMORY.md).
  dot-claude-in-home-dir/README.md written: what the directory is, the two symlinks, how to read a task without Claude Code, how to link it on another machine, the rules for writing there.
  Three task files (324 337 361) held a stray Latin-1 byte 0xA7 and did not parse as UTF-8 JSON: re-encoded (the only change, verified).  All 1,502 files parse now.
CONTENT CHECK (what it covered, honestly): a pattern scan of both stores for e-mail addresses, credentials, personal topics, rude words, blame, token/limit talk and other people or organisations, every hit read in context; every QUOTED USER statement listed and read (81 distinct in the tasks, ~45 in memory: all work directives).  NOT done: a full read of all 8.6 MB.  Found and fixed: ONE personal sentence quoted in the handover memory note (rewritten); one sentence in user_explanation_style.md reworded.  Left as is: mentions of running low on tokens / the session rate limit (the same statements are already public in docs/DECIDED.md and docs/session-log.md).
NOT YET DONE:
  1. COMMIT + PUSH of dot-claude-in-home-dir/ -- it is UNTRACKED in main`s working tree until the USER says publish (first publication of a new class of content).  With the commit: `.dockerignore` gains the directory, `.gitignore` gains tasks/pcl/.lock, CONTRIBUTING.md + CLAUDE.md get a pointer to the README, DECIDED a line.
  2. A test row (tools/t or the gate): every task file parses, its `id` equals its file name, ids unique -- TODAY 407.json 408.json 409.json have an EMPTY `id` field (set it when the row is written).
  3. (c) THE AGENT BRIEFS: ~/pcl-agent-scratch is 4.4 GB, of which the Markdown (COMMON.md, the round briefs, SHARED-BOX / PAUSE / STOP files, plans) is ~11 MB in ~780 files -- but a blind `find -name *.md` also catches repo copies inside base extractions.  Needs a SELECTION (the rulebook, the protocol, the unlaunched briefs and plans, the PAUSE files; history by session) and the same content check; do it when no agent is reading those paths.  The 138 citations of `~/pcl-agent-scratch/...` in docs/ then get a pointer line, not a rewrite.
  4. Next session start: CONFIRM the harness loaded MEMORY.md through the symlink (if it did not: `rm` the link, `mv` the directory back from the repo, and keep a copy step instead).

=== s507 later the same evening: PUBLISHED (USER: "Please do.") -- commit 9fda1646 on main, pushed, CI green on d8ffb255.  Items 1 is DONE. ===
INVENTORY for item 3 (the agent briefs), taken read-only over ~/pcl-agent-scratch with repo extractions and `agent-<hex>` archives pruned: 744 Markdown files, 7.9 MB --
  briefs (prompt* / resume* / brief*) 316 files 2.85 MB | PAUSE (the session running logs; several sessions keep 3-9 versions) 23 files 2.2 MB | STOP (an agent`s state at a stop) 103 files 0.54 MB |
  COMMON (the rulebook; the LIVE one is s473/COMMON.md, the other 22 are copies inside archived agent scratch) 23 files | SHARED-BOX (protocol, one per session since s502) 7 files | plans/designs 8 files |
  notes/records/reports 27 files | other 237 files 2.0 MB (mostly record drafts inside `<label>-agent-<hex>` archives, and two copies of docs/ from a docs review).  Plus 219 review probe files (*.pl under */review/), 0.96 MB.
PROPOSED SELECTION (not started; the USER decides lean vs full): LIVING SET = s473/COMMON.md, the newest SHARED-BOX.md, the newest PAUSE file, every UNLAUNCHED brief and plan (s473t6/plan.md, â¦) -- these are what a successor needs to continue the process; HISTORY = per session the final PAUSE file + the top-level briefs (prompt.md / resume-*.md / *-prompt.md) + plans, no STOP files, no archive drafts, no duplicates (~3-4 MB).  Destination: a top-level directory beside dot-claude-in-home-dir/ with an equally plain name; the 138 `~/pcl-agent-scratch/...` citations in docs/ get ONE pointer line (the relative layout is kept, so a cited path maps by prefix).  The same content check as for the two stores before it is published.  Copy, do not move: the live scratch (measurement output, agent worktree scratch) stays where it is.

=== s507, item 3 DONE ON DISK (USER: "with symbolic links again", a descriptive directory name; lean -- the session history is already docs/session-log.md) ===
/home/bernt/pcl/briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/ = README.md + eight living documents in the layout of ~/pcl-agent-scratch/ (s473/COMMON.md, s473/s473t6/plan.md, s506/s506f-prompt.md, s506/s502e-prompt.md, s507/SHARED-BOX.md, s507/resume-s506f.md, s507/resume-s502e.md, s507/PAUSE-s507.md); each old path is a FILE-level symlink put in place atomically (`ln -s NEW OLD.lnk && mv -T OLD.lnk OLD`), originals backed up in ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s507/briefs-before-move/.  Content check clean.  The Edit / Write tools refuse to write a symlinked file (they name the target), so the links cannot be clobbered by them; `perl -pi` / `sed -i` on the old path WOULD replace the link -- edit the repo path.
NOT committed yet (one commit after the s506f merge).  From now on a session`s protocol and briefs are written in that directory under sNNN/.  The older briefs, PAUSE and STOP files stay in ~/pcl-agent-scratch (not needed by a successor; their conclusions are in docs/session-log.md and docs/DECIDED.md).
STILL OPEN in this task: the parse/id test row for the task store (407 408 409 have an empty id); confirming at the next session start that MEMORY.md loads through the symlink.

=== CONFIRMED 2026-10-05 (USER): a parallel Claude Code session started on this machine loaded MEMORY.md through the symlink and read the task store -- the symlinks work.  Item 4 is DONE.  STILL OPEN in this task: only the parse / id test row for the task store (407 408 409 have an empty `id`). ===
